verdict.rationale: Foreloop's only documented feedback intake is an embeddable widget that end users press to submit a problem report, which an agent then triages into an intention. Nothing shows automatic capture of feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, or chat conversations, and no integrations with those sources are documented. The widget is a related but different intake channel, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations
